paragraphs.text:
The woman remains sullen and angry. Norman suggests tying 
her up for her own safety. Sylvia silences him with a glare and 
offers the woman some of your food.

You are shaken awake in the small hours during Norman’s 
watch. “I’m sorry, Professor. The girl’s gone. I checked on her not five 
minutes ago. She must have been absolutely silent.”

You are not going to intercept a stealthy local in the woods at 
night. And it’s unlikely you could find that clearing again. You 
shrug and go back to sleep.
